info.title: Access roles API
info.description:
Access roles are the replacement of `Permission Groups`. Each `Role` has multiple `Role Configurations`, detailing its checked permissions. Role configurations are split by `origin`. An origin corresponds to a functionality in the TOPdesk application.

At this moment only GET requests are supported.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: A role defines a set of permissions. Users can be assigned to one or more roles. If a user is assigned to multiple roles, they get the permissions of all their roles combined.

tags.name: RoleConfigurations
tags.description: A roleConfiguration is a map between a role and the permissions that are set for this role, for a specific functionality.

tags.name: Reporting
tags.description: The reporting endpoint(s) compliant with the OData reporting layer

get.summary: Reporting Roles endpoint returning what permissions are assigned to what users, and what users have what permissions.
get.description: The endpoint returns all the roles with their assigned permissions and the linked users.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description:
A FIQL string to select which roles should be returned. The supported operators are: * `eq` - equals * `ne` - not equals * `and` - and * `or` - or
(See [FIQL Queries Tutorial](https://developers.topdesk.com/tutorial.html#query)).

The following fields are available for `$filter` parameter: * `id` - role id * `name` - role name * `archived` - role archived status * `target` - role type, supported types: * `default` - general permission group role * `admin` - admin role * `saassupervisor` - SaaS supervisor role * `principals` - list of users linked to the role * `assignedPermissions`- list of permission ids of the assigned permissions checked for the role

200.description: Success - If the `$filter`-parameter is valid the endpoint returns all the roles that meet the condition in the parameter. If `$filter`-parameter is not valid or not specified in the request then the endpoint returns all the roles.

licensed.description: True if the users linked to this role must be paid for. This only applies for the [new pricing model](https://www.topdesk.com/en/pricing/).

modifierId.description: The principalId of the operator that last modified the role. The corresponding operator can be retrieved from the [operator API](https://developers.topdesk.com/explorer/?page=supporting-files#/Operators/retrieveOperators), using the principalId as a query parameter.

creatorId.description: The principalId of the operator that last modified the role. The corresponding operator can be retrieved from the [operator API](https://developers.topdesk.com/explorer/?page=supporting-files#/Operators/retrieveOperators), using the principalId as a query parameter.

target.description: The type of role. This determines which permissions may be set for this role. For the SaaS supervisor role the value is 'saassupervisor', for regular roles, the value is 'default'.

licensed.description: True if the users linked to this role must be paid for. This only applies for the [new pricing model](https://www.topdesk.com/en/pricing/).

from.description: Link to the origin corresponding to this roleConfiguration.

of.description: Link to the role corresponding to this roleConfiguration.

ready.description: Indicates whether this roleConfiguration is currently 'active'. If it is not, saving the role configuration has not fully succeeded yet.
